answer: Shared-error cluster audit. Post-settlement, auditors compute each identity’s residual vector against reference outputs, estimating pairwise similarity with a fixed kernel. A permutation test flags groups whose residuals correlate beyond the null; flagged groups lose pending payouts. Attackers must train separate models or add independent per-identity noise; a shared model yields detectable covariance. Quartz batches test numeric outputs. Canyon batches test spatial outputs. Per-identity cost: extra compute.
